title: A kernel-checked implementation of the biallelic two-locus sampling recursion, and a table checker
abstract: This entry states correctness results, in exact rational arithmetic, for an executable implementation of the two-locus sampling recursion of the coalescent with recombination under parent-independent mutation, with two alleles at each locus. For valid parameters and configurations with the stated array sizes, the computation succeeds and its value equals the solution of the recursion at the decoded configuration. A table checker is shown to be sound and complete: a table that passes the check consists of true values of the recursion, and the table of true values over the closure of configurations of a given size passes. The existence of a solution to the recursion, for any finite numbers of alleles, positive mutation rates, and nonnegative recombination rate, is also stated, together with an explicit characterization of the Boolean parameter-validity test.
